segments.name: retail segment
segments.description: Retailer of casual apparel, footwear, accessories and hardgoods sold through its stores and website to young men, young women, boys and girls.
segments.evidence: Tillys operates in one , consolidated operating and reportable segment, which is as a retailer of casual apparel, footwear, accessories, and hardgoods (the "retail segment").

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for casual apparel, footwear, accessories and hardgoods bought in its stores and on its website.
revenueModel.evidence: The retail segment derives revenues from our stores located in a variety of retail centers in the United States and via our website.
